# Set the game configuration

    name = "Snake",
    direction = "right",
    delay = 10,
    speed = 10,
    color = "green",
    background = "white",
    max_h = 10,
    max_l = 10,
)

# Note: The game will end when the player loses time or the game is over

- **Direction**: The snake moves to the right by default.
- **Controls**: Use arrow keys or "direction" in the game's UI to change direction.
- **Game Over**: The game ends when the snake reaches the end or the time is over.
